inspection.scope: Visible adjoints, SU3-cubed/SU5 bachelor and heavy-messenger definitions; hidden D-breaking completion not invented.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Visible GEM adds one adjoint chiral supermultiplet for each SM gauge factor to MSSM. Each adds a complex adjoint scalar and a LH adjoint Weyl. Hidden U1 D-prime is a SUSY-breaking source, not enough to identify its charged hidden matter.
SU3-cubed completion adds one chiral vector-like pair (1,2,+/-1/2), two pairs (1,1,+/-1), and four SM singlet chiral multiplets beyond visible adjoints.

Displayed heavy messenger T/barT coupling to adjoint does not select all SM/hidden charges or hidden breaking matter. SU5 bachelors complete one adjoint24 into SM adjoints plus (3,2,-5/6)+(bar3,2,+5/6).

source_descriptions.reason: Visible field content is explicit, but source hidden U1 breaking/messenger realization is not a single fixed full spectrum; cannot assert complete inventory across it.
